research_question: How do existing activation compression baselines perform?

sota_configs.name: Uniform-FP8
sota_configs.description: All activations quantized to FP8 (8.0 bits)

sota_configs.name: GACT-Adaptive
sota_configs.description: GACT-style: layer-wise sensitivity-based bit allocation (avg ~4.0 bits)

sota_configs.name: CompAct-Rotate
sota_configs.description: CompAct-style: block-wise random rotation + quantization (avg ~4.0 bits)

sota_configs.name: Random-Mixed-4.8
sota_configs.description: Random 20% FP8 + 80% FP4 (4.8 bits, no importance routing)

sota_configs.name: OAMP-20
sota_configs.description: OAMP bi-level: 20% FP8 anchors + 80% FP4 (4.8 bits, residual only)
